lines.zh: 庞大的身躯一步步推进
lines.en: A massive body advances one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我穿过草原，草全被踩倒
lines.en: I cross the savanna, flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 五格高的身体，走起来地都震
lines.en: Five blocks tall, and the ground shakes as I walk.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后扫来扫去
lines.en: My tail sweeps back and forth behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着山脊走，风从下往上吹
lines.en: I walk the ridge where the wind climbs.

lines.zh: 三格宽的脚掌，一步一个坑
lines.en: Three blocks wide per foot, one pit per step.

lines.zh: 我低头走，眼睛一直扫着地面
lines.en: Head low, my eyes comb the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 荒地的红土在我脚下扬起
lines.en: Red dirt of the badlands rises under me.

lines.zh: 我没有目的地，走到哪算哪
lines.en: I have no destination; wherever I end up is fine.

lines.zh: 走一段我就停，闻闻空气
lines.en: Every so often I stop and taste the air.

lines.zh: 岩群间我侧身挤过
lines.en: I squeeze between the rocks sideways.

lines.zh: 我站直身子，比周围的树高
lines.en: Standing tall, I top the nearby trees.

lines.zh: 头抬起来，鼻孔一张一合
lines.en: Head raised, my nostrils flare and settle.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的动静，很久没动
lines.en: I stare at distant movement, still for a long while.

lines.zh: 牙齿很粗，不是为了咀嚼好看的
lines.en: My teeth are thick, not meant to look pretty.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑着地，我半蹲着休息
lines.en: My tail braced on the ground, I half-crouch to rest.

lines.zh: 风从草原上刮过来，很干燥
lines.en: The savanna wind is dry against my hide.

lines.zh: 我背上晒得发烫
lines.en: The sun is hot on my back.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块岩石
lines.en: I stand perfectly still, like a boulder.

lines.zh: 远处有一群小动物，我看了一眼
lines.en: A herd moves far off; I look at it once.

lines.zh: 脚下有我上一次留下的脚印
lines.en: My old footprints are beneath me.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出很低的震动
lines.en: A low tremor hums in my throat.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把苍蝇赶走
lines.en: I shake my head to chase the flies off.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，站着就不想动
lines.en: A body this size would rather stand than move.

lines.zh: 恶地的热气让远处的东西在晃
lines.en: The badlands heat makes distant things shimmer.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你才到我胸口
lines.en: I lower my head; you reach only my chest.

lines.zh: 你太小了，我先闻一闻
lines.en: You are so small; I sniff first.

lines.zh: 我歪着巨头，评估你的分量
lines.en: I tilt my huge head, weighing you.

lines.zh: 你的动作在我眼里很慢
lines.en: Your movements look slow to me.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，影子盖住你
lines.en: One step, and my shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 我不急着动手，先看你怕不怕
lines.en: I do not rush; I first see if you are afraid.

lines.zh: 你把背对着我，这不明智
lines.en: Turning your back to me is unwise.

lines.zh: 我鼻腔里全是你的气味
lines.en: My nostrils are full of your scent.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，只是呼吸
lines.en: I open my mouth only to breathe.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，像一根小柱子
lines.en: You stand there like a little post.

lines.zh: 我在想你能吃几口
lines.en: I am wondering how many bites you are.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，你该退了
lines.en: We are too close; you should back off.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，回头找你
lines.en: I roar once and turn to find you.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我厚皮上
lines.en: That landed on my thick hide.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一步，很短
lines.en: I stumble one step, briefly.

lines.zh: 血从伤口流到脚边
lines.en: Blood runs down to my feet.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把痛丢到一边
lines.en: I shake my head to throw the pain aside.

lines.zh: 我又转过头来，气势没弱
lines.en: I turn back, undiminished.

lines.zh: 这个身体不容易倒，别高兴
lines.en: This body does not fall easily; do not celebrate.

lines.zh: 我低吼着向前半步
lines.en: With a low growl I step half forward.

lines.zh: 脚下踩出一片乱土
lines.en: My feet scatter the soil.

lines.zh: 我记得是谁咬的
lines.en: I remember who bit me.

lines.zh: 生肉的味道，我立刻转过来
lines.en: Raw meat; I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我低头凑近，嘴张开了
lines.en: I lower my head, mouth opening.

lines.zh: 这么点肉，不够我塞牙
lines.en: That much meat will not fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的手，别抖
lines.en: I sniff your hand; do not tremble.

lines.zh: 我一口能连手一起咬掉
lines.en: One bite would take the hand too.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过来，草都倒了
lines.en: I shuffle closer, flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 肉是好的，但我不急
lines.en: The meat is good, but I am unhurried.

lines.zh: 这点分量，我还是收下
lines.en: Small portion, but I will take it.

lines.zh: 吃完这块，我可能还想要
lines.en: After this piece, I may want more.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我几乎没动
lines.en: You hit my leg; I barely move.

lines.zh: 我撞过来，你被推得很远
lines.en: When I shove, you go far.

lines.zh: 这一下我重心偏了一点
lines.en: That knocked my balance slightly off.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过，带起一片土
lines.en: My tail sweeps past, raising a wall of dust.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，声音很闷
lines.en: We collide with a dull heavy sound.

lines.zh: 我低头看了眼被撞的地方
lines.en: I look down at where you hit me.

lines.zh: 三格宽的身体，挡路就是挡路
lines.en: Three blocks wide: blocking is blocking.

lines.zh: 你退得快，算你聪明
lines.en: You retreat fast; that is smart.

lines.zh: 这点冲击，我只当作挠痒
lines.en: That impact is a scratch to me.

lines.zh: 我把头低到和你一样高
lines.en: I lower my head level with yours.

lines.zh: 我们用鼻子互相蹭
lines.en: We nudge each other with our snouts.

lines.zh: 我刨开一片土，做个浅坑
lines.en: I scrape out a shallow hollow in the dirt.

lines.zh: 两具巨大的身体靠在一起，很暖
lines.en: Two huge bodies lean together for warmth.

lines.zh: 我的声音低得能传过草原
lines.en: My call is low enough to cross the savanna.

lines.zh: 我们轮流看四周，从不一起睡
lines.en: We take turns watching; we never both sleep.

lines.zh: 我把最大的一块肉留给你
lines.en: I leave the biggest piece of meat for you.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印并排留在红土上
lines.en: Our prints lie side by side in the red dirt.

lines.zh: 你的尾巴扫到我的腿，我没动
lines.en: Your tail brushes my leg; I do not move.

lines.zh: 这样的伴，草原上不多
lines.en: A companion like this is rare on the savanna.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，甩起头
lines.en: I bite down and jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 这块太小，我尝不出味
lines.en: Too small to taste.

lines.zh: 这东西硬得咬不动
lines.en: This is too hard to bite.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，才决定
lines.en: I sniff it before deciding.

lines.zh: 叼着走路不方便，我一口吞了
lines.en: Carrying it is awkward, so I swallow.

lines.zh: 我咬成两半，一半掉地上
lines.en: It splits in two; half falls.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，走了两步才放
lines.en: I carry it two steps before dropping it.

lines.zh: 我把骨头咬碎，声音很响
lines.en: I crunch the bone loudly.

lines.zh: 这么点东西，我连嚼都省了
lines.en: So little, I skip chewing.

lines.zh: 你一跑，我的头就转过去了
lines.en: When you run, my head turns.

lines.zh: 这点个子，跑不过我
lines.en: That size cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，草原上没有遮挡
lines.en: I have you; the savanna offers no cover.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔里全是你的味道
lines.en: My nostrils are full of your scent.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了你就跑了
lines.en: I stay quiet; a roar would scare you off.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼过去，不急
lines.en: I close in step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 你的背对着我，这是机会
lines.en: Your back is turned; that is an opportunity.

lines.zh: 我看到了，是那个小的
lines.en: I see it: the small one.

lines.zh: 我开始加速了，地面在响
lines.en: I pick up speed, and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 这地方是我的猎场
lines.en: This ground is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，把牙露出来
lines.en: I open my mouth and show my teeth.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁，路断了
lines.en: You back to a rock wall; the path ends.

lines.zh: 我算你的距离，三步之内
lines.en: I judge the distance: within three strides.

lines.zh: 猎物和石头，我分得清
lines.en: I can tell prey from stone.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脚步沉重却稳
lines.en: I follow you, steps heavy but steady.

lines.zh: 你往哪跑，我就在哪边
lines.en: Wherever you run, that is where I head.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫平了草
lines.en: My tail levels the grass as I chase.

lines.zh: 你在岩缝里挤，我直接撞
lines.en: You squeeze into a crevice; I simply charge it.

lines.zh: 这么慢的东西，我很有耐心
lines.en: For something this slow, I have great patience.

lines.zh: 我每一步都在缩短距离
lines.en: Every step shortens the gap.

lines.zh: 荒地的热气里，你的影子很清楚
lines.en: In the badlands heat, your shadow stands out.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把嘴边的涎水甩掉
lines.en: I shake my head, flinging drool aside.

lines.zh: 你跑不动的时候，我就到了
lines.en: When you can run no more, I will be there.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，只追能追上的
lines.en: I do not chase the fast, only the catchable.

lines.zh: 这块地上没有第二只更大的
lines.en: There is nothing bigger on this ground.

lines.zh: 我低头看路，眼睛没离开你
lines.en: I watch the ground, but my eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，让你的希望多一会儿
lines.en: I pause a moment to let your hope linger.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我还没开始
lines.en: You are panting hard; I have not started.

lines.zh: 我的影子压到你的位置上了
lines.en: My shadow has reached your position.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下，牙齿撞在一起
lines.en: I bite down, teeth clashing.

lines.zh: 巨头一甩，你被掀出去
lines.en: One swing of my head throws you clear.

lines.zh: 一脚踩下，地面陷了
lines.en: One stomp, and the ground caves.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，像一根柱子
lines.en: My tail sweeps like a beam.

lines.zh: 这一口够撕开一头牲畜
lines.en: This bite could rip a livestock animal apart.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下来，你躲不开
lines.en: I crush down from above; you cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 我咬住再甩头，撕扯
lines.en: I bite, whip my head, and tear.

lines.zh: 撞过去的时候，我用了整个身体
lines.en: I hit with my entire body.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的低吼变成了咆哮
lines.en: The low rumble becomes a roar.

lines.zh: 我咬完退开，看着你倒下
lines.en: I back off after the bite to watch you fall.

lines.zh: 第二次我就知道怎么打了
lines.en: On the second try, I know how to hit you.

lines.zh: 脚掌碾过你刚才站的地方
lines.en: My foot grinds where you were standing.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，每一次都是全力
lines.en: With a body this size, every blow is full force.

lines.zh: 红土上传来沉重的闷响
lines.en: A heavy thud rolls across the red dirt.

lines.zh: 我从草原尽头走过来，影子很长
lines.en: I come from the far savanna, my shadow long.

lines.zh: 这地方有草也有石头，正合适
lines.en: Grass and stone here; just right.

lines.zh: 我落地时，附近的动物全散了
lines.en: When I arrive, the nearby animals all scatter.

lines.zh: 一声长啸传过荒地的岩壁
lines.en: A long call echoes off the badlands cliffs.

lines.zh: 我踩塌了一处土坡才站稳
lines.en: I cave in a slope before getting my footing.

lines.zh: 地面震了一下，我才露出身形
lines.en: The ground shakes, then I emerge.

lines.zh: 风把热气压得更低
lines.en: The wind presses the heat even lower.

lines.zh: 我占据了一块高一点的岩石
lines.en: I take a slightly higher rock.

lines.zh: 这里没有人管，我就留下
lines.en: No one keeps order here, so I stay.

lines.zh: 草地上多了一个三格宽的坑
lines.en: The grass now holds a three-block-wide pit.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新鲜的气味
lines.en: I smell something fresh.

lines.zh: 我在山脊上停住，扫视四周
lines.en: I halt on the ridge and scan the land.

lines.zh: 植被被我压开一条路
lines.en: I press a path through the vegetation.

lines.zh: 这么大的家伙，很难不被看见
lines.en: A creature this big is hard to miss.

lines.zh: 火燎上背脊，我大步冲开
lines.en: Fire scorches my spine; I charge clear.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I fall from height and crater the ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻孔，我猛甩头
lines.en: Water pours into my nostrils; I thrash my head.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得侧移
lines.en: The blast shoves me sideways.

lines.zh: 有东西扎在侧腹，像根刺
lines.en: Something sticks in my flank like a thorn.

lines.zh: 一股看不见的东西在啃我
lines.en: Something unseen gnaws at me.

lines.zh: 饿得我连灌木都嚼
lines.en: Hunger has me chewing shrubs.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我全身一紧
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; my whole body clenches.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我开始下坠
lines.en: No ground under me; I begin to fall.
